bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = bf3ace0a37071c32d08a1478994cc969eff2578b28383c529b4cd57b1288034a
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
test "$(loginctl show-user "$(id -un)" -p Linger --value)" = yes
session=deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session
test -f "$session" && test ! -L "$session"
mode="$(stat -c %a "$session")"
test "$mode" = 600
inode="$(stat -c %i "$session")"
pid="$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)"
test "$pid" -gt 0
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py profile_button_smoke
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
test "$(loginctl show-user "$(id -un)" -p Linger --value)" = yes
test "$(stat -c %a "$session")" = "$mode"
test "$(stat -c %i "$session")" = "$inode"
test "$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)" = "$pid"
echo PROFILE_LIVE_EDITOR_OPEN=PASS
echo SESSION_FILE_AND_RESIDENT_PROCESS_UNCHANGED=PASS
